_help._file: How well a bot sees and picks (the AI module). Lowest skill first.
_help.candidates: The most squares it looks at in one move (9 = every one).
_help.spread: 0-1: keep moves within this share of the best (1 = only the best).
_help.topN: …and pick among at most this many of them.
_help.wobble: 0-1: how much its traits wander from turn to turn.
